Definition: from G1537 and G142; to remove:--put (take) away.
BiblicalUsage: The word exaírō carries the sense of put (take) away. In 1 Corinthians 5:13, the text says "But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person."
TheologicalSignificance: I take exaírō as it stands: put away.
